title: 6. Search in Rotated Sorted Array
description:
There is an integer array `nums` sorted in ascending order (with distinct values) that has been rotated at an unknown pivot index. Given the array `nums` and an integer `target`, return the index of `target` if it is in `nums`, or `-1` if it is not in `nums`.

You must write an algorithm with O(log N) runtime complexity.
constraints:
• 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000
• All values in `nums` are unique.
• Optimal Time: O(log N) | Optimal Space: O(1)
explanation: At any pivot split, at least one half of the array is guaranteed to be normally sorted. By checking whether `target` falls inside the endpoints of the sorted half, the algorithm deterministically discards half the array on each step in O(log N) time.
